South Africa Mass Shootings Leave Over 30 Dead

Over the weekend, at least 27 people were killed in separate mass shootings across South African townships, with the death toll later rising to 28 after another victim died. A third mass shooting also occurred, bringing the total number of fatalities from weekend violence to over 30. Police have launched manhunts for the gunmen involved.
